text.tspan: Recommendation: 1 server with 2× NVIDIA B300 SXM serves 2,000 users chatting, with conversations
of up to 32k tokens (≈ 25,000 words ≈ 49 pages; 16k on average). Caution: each server runs at
98% of its guaranteed capacity, so waits grow fast with more traffic: one more server leaves
Alternative: 3 servers with 1× NVIDIA H200 SXM 141GB each (≈ 800 users per server).
Not enough: RTX 5080, even with 4 GPUs in one server.
Speed for each user: writing about 19 words per second (15 to 23; 25 tokens/s); with everyone busy
the first words appear after about 0.07 s, and a full 32k-token request alone is read in about
Confidence: memory high (±8.0%); writing speed medium (±21%); reading time medium (±37%); user
count medium (±21%). Plan on the guaranteed figures.
